lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: The self-checkout just accused me of stealing a banana.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: No! I scanned it. It said unexpected item.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: It's a supermarket. Bananas are the whole point!

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: A light started flashing. Everyone turned around.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: I apologised to it. Out loud. Twice.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: It printed a receipt this long. Mostly warnings.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: You scanned, bagged, and got told off. That's a shift.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Wait. Do I work there now?

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Unpaid. And you're on again Saturday.
